title: The 5 Best Dehumidifiers for Crawl Spaces
h1: The 5 Best Dehumidifiers for Crawl Spaces
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for dehumidifiers for crawl spaces, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dehumidifiers for crawl spaces using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Frigidaire FFAP5033W1 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day moisture removal, 4,500 sq ft coverage, Built-in condensate pump for hands-off continuous drainage, Rated to operate down to 41°F, typical of an unheated crawl space.
strengths: 41°F operating floor is a real advantage in a crawl space that runs colder than the living space above
Built-in pump handles drainage without anyone climbing back in to check a bucket
Washable filter is a quick rinse rather than a special-order replacement part
limitations: Larger footprint than some dedicated crawl space units, worth measuring clearance first
Casters aren't useful on a dirt or gravel crawl space floor
Higher typical price than the Vremi for the same 50-pint rating
features: Built-in condensate pump for hands-off continuous drainage
Rated to operate down to 41°F, typical of an unheated crawl space
Washable filter and Energy Star certification

products.name: TOSOT 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Internal Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft, Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through a 19-foot hose, Energy Star certified and UL listed.
strengths: 15-foot pump lift and long hose reach an outside vent or drain far from the crawl space access point
Auto-restart means the unit doesn't sit off after a breaker trip until someone crawls back in
52-decibel peak sound level is a non-issue in an unoccupied crawl space
limitations: Owner reports note compressor longevity concerns after 2 to 3 seasons of heavy continuous use
Bucket-full sensor is sensitive and occasionally halts operation prematurely
Control panel access requires crawling back in to adjust settings
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft
Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through a 19-foot hose
Energy Star certified and UL listed
Auto-restart resumes settings after a power interruption

products.name: Vremi 50-Pint Dehumidifier for 4,500 Sq Ft Spaces
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft, Continuous drain hose option alongside the 1.8-gallon tank, Energy Star certified compressor.
strengths: Lowest typical price of the continuous-drain-capable units in this roundup
Continuous drain hose option avoids manual bucket checks in a space nobody wants to crawl into often
Energy Star certification keeps a long duty cycle reasonably affordable
limitations: No pump, so drainage depends on the hose running continuously downhill to an exit point
Housing feels less durable for years of crawl space conditions than the Frigidaire
Runs louder than the Frigidaire at comparable settings, though this rarely matters in an unoccupied space
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft
Continuous drain hose option alongside the 1.8-gallon tank

products.name: ALORAIR Sentinel HDi65S Crawlspace Dehumidifier
strengths: Low profile fits tight crawl spaces
limitations: Capacity ratings vary by test standard
Needs professional-style install for best results

products.name: AprilAire E070 Pro 70-Pint Crawl Space Dehumidifier
strengths: Removes up to 70 pints per day
Designed and made in the USA
